headline: Committee heard updates on real-time bus tracking and CDBG projects; no other business conducted.
summary: The Human Affairs Committee received a presentation on real-time bus information from Transit Administrator Camille Correa and an update on FY26 and FY27 CDBG projects from Urban Program Manager Mike Jungers. The Revive Recovery Resource Center did not present. There was no new business, communications, or public comment.
